meta.subject: fixed FPU handshake, optimized writeback's critical path

en.summary: Fixes a real FPU decoupled-handshake bug. The FPU input now reports ready while idle, instead of mirroring only the internal backend-ready signal and spuriously appearing busy.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says the FPU handshake is fixed.
The patch changes FPU RTL plus related issue/scheduler/writeback control logic.
The key hunk corrects the ready condition itself, which directly affects forward progress.
disqualifiers: The commit also contains scheduler/writeback restructuring and interface type cleanup.
evidence: VX_fpnew.v changes in_ready from fpu_in_ready to fpu_in_ready || ~in_valid, with an inline comment describing it as a handshake fix.
VX_issue.v and VX_scheduler.v rework busy/stall handling around execution-unit readiness in the same commit.
VX_writeback.v is restructured to keep metadata and writeback data coherent, showing the commit is control-correctness oriented, not only timing-oriented.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a ready/valid interface, a unit that is currently idle must advertise readiness even before a new input arrives. If ready is tied only to a deeper backend-ready signal, the unit can look busy while holding no work, creating false backpressure and, in some pipelines, deadlock because upstream logic waits for ready before asserting valid.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: idle-state ready semantics on a decoupled FPU input
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The FPU input stage is empty, but the internal backend-ready signal is low or participates in a handshake loop with upstream issue logic.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the idle-case from the ready equation so input ready depends only on backend readiness.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: tie ready only to downstream ready
portability_notes: This maps to any decoupled or ready/valid execution unit with an internal input register or pipeline stage.
The bug is about forward-progress semantics, not floating-point arithmetic itself.
If the target design has a skid buffer or implicit holding register, treat the empty-buffer case as the portable analogue of ~in_valid.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the ready output on the FPU or long-latency execution unit input interface.
Identify the local state bit that says whether that interface already holds a valid request.
Delete the part of the ready equation that keeps ready high while no request is currently held.
Leave the internal compute pipeline unchanged so the reinjected failure is pure handshake/backpressure behavior.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes in_ready to fpu_in_ready || ~in_valid so the FPU advertises readiness when it is not currently holding a valid input.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change assign in_ready = fpu_in_ready || ~in_valid back to assign in_ready = fpu_in_ready.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Floating-point requests experience false backpressure, can stop issuing under specific handshake dependencies, and may deadlock or stall even though the FPU input stage is idle.
evidence_for_injection: The functional fix is a single ready-equation change on the FPU input interface.
The inline source comment explicitly identifies the line as the handshake fix.
The associated issue/scheduler changes in the same commit are consistent with a forward-progress problem around execution-unit readiness.
notes: The chosen injection target is the cleanest isolated sub-fix in a broader control-path commit.
This bug is highly reusable on any ready/valid unit that can falsely look busy while empty.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了真实的 FPU decoupled 握手缺陷。修复后，FPU 输入在空闲时会正确报告 ready，而不再只镜像内部 backend-ready 信号并错误地表现为忙碌。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确写明修复了 FPU handshake。
补丁同时修改了 FPU RTL 以及相关的 issue/scheduler/writeback 控制逻辑。
关键 hunk 直接修正了 ready 条件本身，这会直接影响前进性。
disqualifiers: 该提交还包含 scheduler/writeback 重构以及接口类型清理。
evidence: VX_fpnew.v 把 in_ready 从 fpu_in_ready 改成了 fpu_in_ready || ~in_valid，并在行内注释里明确说这是 handshake fix。
同一提交中的 VX_issue.v 和 VX_scheduler.v 也重构了执行单元 ready 周围的 busy/stall 处理。
VX_writeback.v 被重构以保证元数据与写回数据一致，说明该提交关心的是控制正确性，而不仅是时序。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 ready/valid 接口中，一个当前空闲的执行单元必须在新输入到来之前就宣告 ready。如果 ready 只绑定到更深层的 backend-ready 信号，那么单元在没有持有任何工作时也会看起来像忙碌，从而产生错误背压；在某些流水线中，如果上游要等 ready 才会拉高 valid，甚至会形成死锁。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: decoupled FPU 输入在空闲态的 ready 语义
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: FPU 输入级为空，但内部 backend-ready 为低，或者它参与了与上游发射逻辑的握手回环。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除 ready 方程中的空闲分支，使输入 ready 只取决于 backend 是否 ready。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: tie ready only to downstream ready
portability_notes: 适用于任何带内部输入寄存器或流水级的 decoupled/ready-valid 执行单元。
该缺陷是前进性/握手语义问题，不是浮点运算本身错误。
如果目标设计使用 skid buffer 或隐式 holding register，可把“缓冲区为空”视作这里的 ~in_valid 对应物。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 FPU 或长延迟执行单元输入接口上的 ready 输出。
确定表示该接口当前是否已经持有有效请求的本地状态位。
删除 ready 方程中“当前没有持有请求时也保持 ready 为高”的那一部分。
保持内部计算流水线不变，使回注故障只表现为握手/背压问题。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_fpnew 中输入 ready 的生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 in_ready 改为 fpu_in_ready || ~in_valid，使 FPU 在当前未持有有效输入时仍然报告 ready。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 assign in_ready = fpu_in_ready || ~in_valid 改回 assign in_ready = fpu_in_ready。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 浮点请求会遭遇错误背压，在特定握手依赖下无法继续发射，即使 FPU 输入级实际处于空闲状态，也可能出现死锁或长时间停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 功能性修复就是 FPU 输入接口上一条 ready 方程的改动。
源码行内注释明确指出这就是握手修复点。
同一提交中 issue/scheduler 的相关改动也与执行单元 ready 周围的前进性问题一致。
notes: 在一个较大的控制路径提交中，这里选取的是最干净、最容易隔离回注的子修复。
该缺陷非常适合迁移到任何“空闲时却错误显示 busy”的 ready/valid 单元。
